formulas.ascii: For dense patch label p (row p-1): n_p = pixels with that label; area = n_p * |a*e - b*d| of the grid affine (14400 m2 here); a pixel face is exposed when its 4-neighbour holds another label, background or an invalid pixel, or lies outside the raster (countRasterBorder true); perimeter = (exposed faces between vertical neighbours) * column step + (exposed faces between horizontal neighbours) * row step (120 m here); holes add their inner boundary. All counts are exact integer atomics; while the labelling has not converged every column is filled with the unresolved sentinel (NaN for floats).
